sensors.name: right light sensor RLIGHT, compared with 75 %

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the right light is above 75 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Get through the tunnel from the bright light into the dark.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads more than 75 %

branches.outcome: bright light: it drives forward at 30 %
75 % or less, dim light: it calls stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: the front obstacle sensor sees an obstacle

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it calls followLine

input_dimensions.dimension: what is ahead in the dark
what the line tracker sees in the dark
what is ahead in the dark

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it drives forward at 30 %; in the dark, with nothing ahead, it follows the line: it curves left on black and right on the floor.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts in bright light facing a tunnel, with a line running through the tunnel.
scenarios.trigger: It drives into the darker part of the tunnel.
scenarios.title: Gets through the tunnel
assumptions: You didn't say how it gets through: your program follows a line in the dark, so the tunnel has a line.

scenarios.coded_response: It calls stopAtWall and, with an obstacle ahead, stops.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is inside a tunnel in dim light, with a wall ahead.
scenarios.trigger: The front obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at a wall in the dark
assumptions: You didn't say what it should do at a wall in the dark; your program stops.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the wall without bumping into it.

uncertainties: You didn't say how the robot gets through the dark; without a line your program curves right in the dark.
